hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'docker-compose '; then echo 'BLOCK: Use "docker compose" (V2 syntax), not "docker-compose" (legacy).'; exit 2; fi

if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'cd api.*npm test|api/.*npm test' && ! echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '\-\-runInBand'; then echo 'BLOCK: Backend tests must use --runInBand to prevent DB conflicts.'; exit 2; fi
